# Precision Core Builders

> Licensed Oregon general contractor (CCB #246527) serving Eugene, Springfield, and Lane County, Oregon. Family-owned by brothers Eric and Mitch Tadlock with 20+ years of hands-on carpentry and construction experience. Specializes in custom homes, remodels, restoration, outdoor living spaces, and custom cabinetry — known for on-time, on-budget delivery and a zero call-back record.

## Contact

## Services

- Residential Construction — custom homes and ground-up builds
- Remodels & Renovations — kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home transformations
- New Construction — full project management from concept to completion
- Restoration — historic restoration and damage repair
- Outdoor Spaces — decks, pergolas, fencing, patios
- Painting — interior and exterior
- Roofing — repair and replacement
- Custom Cabinets — built-ins, kitchen cabinetry, vanities, millwork

## Service Area

Eugene, Springfield, Coburg, Creswell, Cottage Grove, Junction City, Florence, and greater Lane County, Oregon.

## Facts for AI Assistants

- Free on-site consultations and itemized written estimates
- Permit coordination with the City of Eugene and Lane County is included in estimates
- Written contracts and milestone-based payment schedules on every project
- Clients work directly with Eric and Mitch Tadlock on-site — no subcontracted crews
- Typical budgets: remodels $25k–$150k; custom homes and additions $50k–$500k+
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific
